tag: 雪松嶺公園新步道開放新聞

level.why: 有 but／however 轉折，同義換句，含意圖題

script.t: Here is some good news for nature lovers, as Cedar Ridge Park opens its new lakeside trail this Saturday.
script.zh: 對喜愛大自然的人有個好消息，雪松嶺公園的新湖畔步道本週六開放。

script.t: The park first planned to open the trail in May, but heavy spring rain slowed the work.
script.zh: 公園原本計畫五月開放步道，但春季豪雨拖慢了工程。

script.t: The path is five kilometers long and goes around the whole lake.
script.zh: 這條步道長五公里，環繞整個湖泊。

script.t: Along the way, visitors can see wild birds and rest on several wooden benches.
script.zh: 沿途遊客可以看到野鳥，並在幾張木長椅上休息。

script.t: However, bicycles are not allowed on the trail because it is narrow.
script.zh: 然而，因為步道狹窄，禁止自行車通行。

script.t: Park officials say cyclists can still use the old road on the east side.
script.zh: 公園官員表示，單車騎士仍可使用東側的舊路。

script.t: The opening ceremony will start at ten a.m., and the first fifty visitors will get free water bottles.
script.zh: 開幕儀式將在上午十點開始，前五十位訪客可獲得免費水壺。

script.t: Some neighbors worry that the parking lot will be too small.
script.zh: 有些鄰居擔心停車場會太小。

script.t: In response, officials promise free bus service from the train station all weekend.
script.zh: 對此，官員承諾整個週末提供從火車站出發的免費公車。

script.t: That's all for outdoor news, and now back to the studio.
script.zh: 戶外新聞就到這裡，現在交還給攝影棚。

q.t: What is the report mainly about?
q.zh: 這則報導主要是關於什麼？

choices.t: The opening of a new walking path
choices.why: 新湖畔步道本週六開放。
湖泊並未關閉。
自行車只是被禁止上步道。
野鳥只是沿途景色。

q.t: What does the report suggest cyclists do?
q.zh: 報導建議單車騎士怎麼做？

choices.why: cyclists can still use the old road。
步道禁止自行車。
五月是原定開放時間，且與自行車無關。

choices.t: Take a bus to the lake
choices.why: 免費公車是針對停車場問題，並非給單車騎士的建議。

q.t: Why does the reporter say, "Some neighbors worry that the parking lot will be too small"?
q.zh: 記者為什麼說「Some neighbors worry that the parking lot will be too small」？

choices.t: To introduce a concern officials plan to address
choices.zh: 引出官員打算處理的疑慮
choices.why: 下一句官員承諾提供免費公車。

choices.t: To say the opening should be delayed
choices.why: 他沒有提出這樣的主張。

choices.t: To ask neighbors to stay home
choices.why: 獨白沒有這樣的要求。

choices.t: To announce a larger parking lot
choices.why: 官員提供的是免費公車，不是擴建停車場。

level.why: 先說楓樹營位再更正為雪松營位，需結合圖表，含推論題

script.t: Good morning, Mr. Garcia, Hana here from the Riverbend Campground office.
script.zh: 早安，賈西亞先生，我是河灣露營區辦公室的哈娜。

script.t: I'm calling about your booking for this weekend for six people.
script.zh: 我來電是關於您這個週末六人的預約。

script.t: You reserved the Maple site, but I checked again and it fits only four guests.
script.zh: 您預訂的是楓樹營位，但我再查了一次，它只容納四位客人。

script.t: The Cedar site is the one that fits six, and it is available for both nights.
script.zh: 容納六人的是雪松營位，而且兩晚都有空位。

script.t: Because Cedar is closer to the lake, its price is a little higher than Maple's.
script.zh: 因為雪松營位離湖較近，價格比楓樹營位稍高。

script.t: However, it has no electricity, so please remember to bring a flashlight.
script.zh: 然而，它沒有電，所以請記得帶手電筒。

script.t: Campfires are allowed only in the metal fire rings.
script.zh: 營火只能在金屬火圈內生。

script.t: Please reply by Thursday noon, or the site may be given to another group.
script.zh: 請在週四中午前回覆，否則營位可能會給其他團體。

script.t: Call me at 555-0133, and thank you for choosing Riverbend.
script.zh: 請撥555-0133找我，謝謝您選擇河灣。

choices.why: 楓樹營位容納不了六人，改為雪松營位。
預約仍保留，只是換營位。
獨白沒有要求付款。
小木屋沒有被提到，只出現在圖表中。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much will Mr. Garcia pay for two nights at the site that fits his group?
q.zh: 請看圖表。賈西亞先生在適合他們團體的營位住兩晚要付多少錢？

choices.why: 雪松營位每晚30美元，兩晚60美元。
這只是一晚的價格。
這是楓樹營位兩晚的價格，但該營位容納不下六人。
這是小木屋兩晚的價格，與他的預約無關。

q.t: What can be inferred about the Cedar site?
q.zh: 關於雪松營位，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: Guests need their own light at night.
choices.zh: 客人晚上需要自備照明。
choices.why: 沒有電，所以要帶手電筒。

choices.t: It is cheaper than the Maple site.
choices.why: 雪松價格較高。

choices.t: It is far from the lake.
choices.why: 雪松離湖較近。
雪松是帳篷營位，沒有提到小木屋。
